slot.brief: Match commonly used antiseptic chemicals (dettol, bithionol, iodine tincture) with their use.

stem:
Match the antiseptic preparations in List-I with their descriptions in List-II:

**List-I**
(P) Bithionol
(Q) Tincture of iodine
(R) Dettol

**List-II**
(1) $2\text{--}3\%$ solution of $\text{I}_2$ in an alcohol–water mixture
(2) Mixture of chloroxylenol and terpineol
(3) Substance added to soaps to impart antiseptic properties

Choose the correct match from the options given below:

verdicts.working: Bithionol is added to soaps for antiseptic action (P-3); tincture of iodine is a 2–3% I2 solution in alcohol–water (Q-1); Dettol is a mixture of chloroxylenol and terpineol (R-2).

working:
According to NCERT Class 12 Chemistry (Chemistry in Everyday Life):
1. Bithionol is added to soaps to impart antiseptic properties and decrease bacterial growth that causes odour (P $\rightarrow$ 3).
2. Tincture of iodine is a $2\text{--}3\%$ solution of iodine ($\text{I}_2$) in an alcohol–water mixture, used as an antiseptic on wounds (Q $\rightarrow$ 1).
3. Dettol is a widely used antiseptic consisting of a mixture of chloroxylenol and terpineol (R $\rightarrow$ 2).

Hence, the correct matching is P-3, Q-1, R-2.

Independent check: Bithionol is added to soaps for antiseptic action (P-3); tincture of iodine is a 2–3% I2 solution in alcohol–water (Q-1); Dettol is a mixture of chloroxylenol and terpineol (R-2).
